bitcoin_merchant_maps_list_your_business: Bitcoin Merchant Maps - List your business for free
biz_maps_hero_title: Get your business on Bitcoin merchant maps
biz_maps_hero_subtitle: List your business for free on BTC Map — the open, worldwide directory of Bitcoin-accepting merchants — so Bitcoiners nearby can find you and spend Bitcoin at your business.
biz_maps_intro_c1: Bitcoiners actively look for places to spend. Getting your business on the map puts you in front of every Bitcoin user searching for somewhere to eat, shop, or stay nearby — at zero cost to you.
biz_maps_intro_c2: Just fill out the short form below and we'll submit your business to BTC Map and other Bitcoin merchant maps for you.
biz_maps_form_intro: We only need a few details to get you listed. Address data is kept only long enough to submit your business to the maps.
